## `profile.json`

Who the owner is: hero, About section and résumé header (PRD FR-07 to FR-10, FR-50). No street address.

One object:

| Field                        | Required | Type           | Rules                                                    | Notes                                                                                         |
| ---------------------------- | -------- | -------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`                       | yes      | string         |                                                          |                                                                                               |
| `headline`                   | yes      | string         | at most 80 characters                                    |                                                                                               |
| `roles`                      | yes      | list of string | at least 1                                               | Rotating hero line (typewriter).                                                              |
| `summary`                    | yes      | string         | at most 200 characters                                   | Hero lead paragraph.                                                                          |
| `about`                      | yes      | list of string | at least 1                                               | First-person About story, one paragraph each.                                                 |
| `location`                   | yes      | object         |                                                          |                                                                                               |
| `location.city`              | yes      | string         |                                                          |                                                                                               |
| `location.country`           | yes      | string         |                                                          |                                                                                               |
| `photo`                      | yes      | object         |                                                          | Hero portrait (FR-50).                                                                        |
| `photo.src`                  | yes      | string         | pattern `^profile/[a-z0-9-]+\.(webp\|jpe?g\|png\|avif)$` | Under src/assets (DS-17: it and its AVIF and WebP exports from pnpm ds:portraits must exist). |
| `photo.alt`                  | yes      | string         |                                                          |                                                                                               |
| `photo.width`                | yes      | integer        | ≥ 1                                                      | Pixel width of the file (DS-17).                                                              |
| `photo.height`               | yes      | integer        | ≥ 1                                                      | Pixel height of the file (DS-17).                                                             |
| `aboutPhoto`                 |          | object         |                                                          | About section portrait (PortraitPlate).                                                       |
| `aboutPhoto.src`             | yes      | string         | pattern `^profile/[a-z0-9-]+\.(webp\|jpe?g\|png\|avif)$` | Under src/assets (DS-17: it and its AVIF and WebP exports from pnpm ds:portraits must exist). |
| `aboutPhoto.alt`             | yes      | string         |                                                          |                                                                                               |
| `aboutPhoto.width`           | yes      | integer        | ≥ 1                                                      | Pixel width of the file (DS-17).                                                              |
| `aboutPhoto.height`          | yes      | integer        | ≥ 1                                                      | Pixel height of the file (DS-17).                                                             |
| `contactPhoto`               |          | object         |                                                          | Contact section photo (ContactPhoto).                                                         |
| `contactPhoto.src`           | yes      | string         | pattern `^profile/[a-z0-9-]+\.(webp\|jpe?g\|png\|avif)$` | Under src/assets (DS-17: it and its AVIF and WebP exports from pnpm ds:portraits must exist). |
| `contactPhoto.alt`           | yes      | string         |                                                          |                                                                                               |
| `contactPhoto.width`         | yes      | integer        | ≥ 1                                                      | Pixel width of the file (DS-17).                                                              |
| `contactPhoto.height`        | yes      | integer        | ≥ 1                                                      | Pixel height of the file (DS-17).                                                             |
| `notFoundPhoto`              |          | object         |                                                          | Not-found page photo (NotFoundSection), the thinking pose.                                    |
| `notFoundPhoto.src`          | yes      | string         | pattern `^profile/[a-z0-9-]+\.(webp\|jpe?g\|png\|avif)$` | Under src/assets (DS-17: it and its AVIF and WebP exports from pnpm ds:portraits must exist). |
| `notFoundPhoto.alt`          | yes      | string         |                                                          |                                                                                               |
| `notFoundPhoto.width`        | yes      | integer        | ≥ 1                                                      | Pixel width of the file (DS-17).                                                              |
| `notFoundPhoto.height`       | yes      | integer        | ≥ 1                                                      | Pixel height of the file (DS-17).                                                             |
| `careerStart`                | yes      | string         | pattern `^\d{4}-(0[1-9]\|1[0-2])$`                       | First month of professional work; years of experience are computed from it (FR-11).           |
| `availability`               | yes      | object         |                                                          |                                                                                               |
| `availability.status`        | yes      | one of         | `available`, `limited`, `unavailable`                    |                                                                                               |
| `availability.message`       | yes      | string         |                                                          |                                                                                               |
| `languages`                  | yes      | list of object | at least 1                                               |                                                                                               |
| `languages[].name`           | yes      | string         |                                                          |                                                                                               |
| `languages[].proficiency`    | yes      | string         |                                                          |                                                                                               |
| `languages[].level`          |          | string         |                                                          | Résumé proficiency, e.g. Professional working, Native.                                        |
| `education`                  | yes      | list of object |                                                          |                                                                                               |
| `education[].title`          | yes      | string         |                                                          |                                                                                               |
| `education[].institution`    |          | string         |                                                          |                                                                                               |
| `education[].start`          | yes      | integer        | ≥ 1950                                                   |                                                                                               |

| `updatedAt`                  | yes      | string         | date                                                     | YYYY-MM-DD; drives the résumé PDF metadata.                                                   |

## `skills.json`

Technologies, grouped by area (PRD FR-11, FR-12). Years are computed from `since`, so they never go stale. Each résumé picks its skills in resumes.json.

A list of skill records (at least 1). Each record:

| Field      | Required | Type    | Rules                                                                           | Notes                                                                |
| ---------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`       | yes      | string  | pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`                                            |                                                                      |
| `name`     | yes      | string  |                                                                                 |                                                                      |
| `category` | yes      | one of  | `Languages`, `Frontend`, `Backend`, `Mobile`, `Data`, `Cloud & DevOps`, `Tools` |                                                                      |
| `since`    |          | integer | ≥ 2000; ≤ 2100                                                                  | First year of use; shown as current year - since. Omit when unknown. |
| `level`    |          | one of  | `expert`, `advanced`, `intermediate`                                            | Optional self-rating.                                                |
| `featured` | yes      | boolean |                                                                                 | Shown first in its group.                                            |
| `icon`     | yes      | string  | pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`                                            | Design-system icon name.                                             |

## `experience.json`

Work history: organizations with their roles (PRD FR-13 to FR-16). The timeline orders roles itself (current first, then newest), so file order doesn't matter. Each résumé picks its roles in resumes.json.

A list of experience records (at least 1). Each record:

| Field                | Required | Type                     | Rules                                                           | Notes                                                                     |
| -------------------- | -------- | ------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`                 | yes      | string                   | pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`                            |                                                                           |
| `organization`       | yes      | string                   |                                                                 | Display name on the site, e.g. Simple Finance.                            |
| `legalName`          |          | string                   |                                                                 | Name on the résumés when it differs, e.g. Simple Finance Company Limited. |
| `website`            |          | string                   | uri; pattern `^https://`                                        |                                                                           |
| `logo`               |          | string                   | pattern `^clients/[a-z0-9-]+\.(png\|svg\|webp)$`                | Under src/assets (shared with clients.json).                              |
| `roles`              | yes      | list of object           | at least 1                                                      |                                                                           |
| `roles[].id`         | yes      | string                   | pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`                            |                                                                           |
| `roles[].title`      | yes      | string                   |                                                                 |                                                                           |
| `roles[].type`       |          | one of                   | `full-time`, `part-time`, `contract`, `freelance`, `internship` |                                                                           |
| `roles[].location`   |          | string                   |                                                                 |                                                                           |
| `roles[].start`      | yes      | string                   | pattern `^\d{4}(-(0[1-9]\|1[0-2]))?$`                           | YYYY-MM, or a bare YYYY when the month isn't known.                       |
| `roles[].end`        |          | string                   | pattern `^\d{4}(-(0[1-9]\|1[0-2]))?$`                           | No end means the role is current.                                         |
| `roles[].summary`    | yes      | string                   | at most 200 characters                                          |                                                                           |
| `roles[].brief`      |          | string                   | at most 160 characters                                          | One line for a résumé's "Earlier experience" list.                        |
| `roles[].highlights` | yes      | list of string or object |                                                                 |                                                                           |
| `roles[].skills`     | yes      | list of string           | no repeats; each: pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`          | Skill ids from skills.json (DS-05).                                       |

## `services.json`

The services offered (PRD FR-17 to FR-19). One record per /services/:slug page.

A list of service records (at least 1). Each record:

| Field                       | Required | Type           | Rules                                                                                          | Notes                                                                                                                      |
| --------------------------- | -------- | -------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`                        | yes      | string         | pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`                                                           |                                                                                                                            |
| `slug`                      | yes      | string         | pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`                                                           | URL segment: /services/<slug>.                                                                                             |
| `title`                     | yes      | string         | at most 80 characters                                                                          |                                                                                                                            |
| `summary`                   | yes      | string         | at most 200 characters                                                                         | Card and meta description line.                                                                                            |
| `audience`                  | yes      | string         |                                                                                                | Who it is for.                                                                                                             |
| `deliverables`              | yes      | list of string | at least 1                                                                                     |                                                                                                                            |
| `process`                   | yes      | list of object | at least 1                                                                                     |                                                                                                                            |
| `process[].step`            | yes      | integer        | ≥ 1                                                                                            |                                                                                                                            |
| `process[].title`           | yes      | string         |                                                                                                |                                                                                                                            |
| `process[].description`     | yes      | string         |                                                                                                |                                                                                                                            |
| `engagement`                | yes      | list of object | at least 1                                                                                     |                                                                                                                            |
| `engagement[].id`           | yes      | string         | pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`                                                           |                                                                                                                            |
| `engagement[].title`        | yes      | string         |                                                                                                |                                                                                                                            |
| `engagement[].description`  | yes      | string         |                                                                                                |                                                                                                                            |
| `pricing`                   | yes      | object         |                                                                                                | v1 shows no figures: model "quote" with the label "Get a quote". "from" needs an amount and currency.                      |
| `pricing.model`             | yes      | one of         | `quote`, `from`                                                                                |                                                                                                                            |
| `pricing.label`             |          | string         |                                                                                                | Button and price text, e.g. "Get a quote".                                                                                 |
| `pricing.from`              |          | number         | > 0                                                                                            |                                                                                                                            |
| `pricing.currency`          |          | string         | pattern `^[A-Z]{3}$`                                                                           |                                                                                                                            |
| `faq`                       | yes      | list of object |                                                                                                |                                                                                                                            |
| `faq[].question`            | yes      | string         |                                                                                                |                                                                                                                            |
| `faq[].answer`              | yes      | string         |                                                                                                |                                                                                                                            |
| `booking`                   | yes      | object         |                                                                                                | The four booking channels (FR-19), each prefilled with the service name where the channel allows.                          |
| `booking.schedulerUrl`      | yes      | string         | uri; pattern `^https://`                                                                       | The booking calendar's link; "Open in a new tab" and the fallback without JavaScript.                                      |
| `booking.schedulerEmbedUrl` |          | string         | uri; pattern `^https://calendar\.google\.com/calendar/appointments/schedules/[\w-]+\?gv=true$` | The Google Calendar appointment schedule's embed URL, framed in the SchedulerModal (the only frame source the CSP allows). |
| `booking.email`             | yes      | string         | pattern `^mailto:[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+`                                                     |                                                                                                                            |
| `booking.whatsapp`          | yes      | string         | uri; pattern `^https://wa\.me/\d+`                                                             |                                                                                                                            |
| `booking.phone`             | yes      | string         | pattern `^tel:\+\d{7,15}$`                                                                     |                                                                                                                            |
| `icon`                      | yes      | string         | pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`                                                           | Design-system icon name, e.g. lightbulb, code, credit-card.                                                                |
| `order`                     | yes      | integer        | ≥ 1                                                                                            | Sort position on the grid (ascending).                                                                                     |

## `projects.json`

Projects for the gallery and /projects/:slug (PRD FR-20 to FR-23). Private projects show the role and stack and never link out.

A list of project records (at least 1). Each record:

| Field             | Required | Type           | Rules                                                                           | Notes                                |
| ----------------- | -------- | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `id`              | yes      | string         | pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`                                            |                                      |
| `slug`            | yes      | string         | pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`                                            | URL segment: /projects/<slug>.       |
| `title`           | yes      | string         | at most 80 characters                                                           |                                      |
| `summary`         | yes      | string         | at most 200 characters                                                          |                                      |
| `category`        | yes      | string         |                                                                                 |                                      |
| `status`          | yes      | one of         | `completed`, `in-progress`, `maintained`, `archived`                            |                                      |
| `visibility`      | yes      | one of         | `public`, `private`                                                             |                                      |
| `featured`        | yes      | boolean        |                                                                                 | On the home grid; at most 6 (DS-08). |
| `stack`           | yes      | list of string | at least 1; no repeats; each: pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`              | Skill ids from skills.json (DS-05).  |
| `role`            |          | string         |                                                                                 |                                      |
| `outcome`         |          | string         |                                                                                 |                                      |
| `startedAt`       | yes      | string         | pattern `^\d{4}(-(0[1-9]\|1[0-2]))?$`                                           |                                      |
| `completedAt`     |          | string         | pattern `^\d{4}(-(0[1-9]\|1[0-2]))?$`                                           |                                      |
| `cover`           |          | string         | pattern `^projects/[a-z0-9-]+/[a-z0-9-]+\.(webp\|png\|jpe?g\|avif\|svg)$`       |                                      |
| `gallery`         |          | list of string | each: pattern `^projects/[a-z0-9-]+/[a-z0-9-]+\.(webp\|png\|jpe?g\|avif\|svg)$` |                                      |
| `links`           | yes      | object         |                                                                                 |                                      |
| `links.live`      |          | string         | uri; pattern `^https://`                                                        |                                      |
| `links.source`    |          | string         | uri; pattern `^https://`                                                        |                                      |
| `links.caseStudy` |          | string         | uri; pattern `^https://`                                                        |                                      |
| `engage`          |          | object         |                                                                                 |                                      |
| `engage.mode`     | yes      | one of         | `request-access`, `request-demo`, `contact`                                     |                                      |
| `engage.note`     | yes      | string         |                                                                                 |                                      |

## `contact.json`

How to reach the owner (PRD FR-27 to FR-30). City and country only: a street address is never stored.

One object:

| Field              | Required | Type           | Rules                                | Notes                                                                 |
| ------------------ | -------- | -------------- | ------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `email`            | yes      | string         | email                                | Plain address; pages build the mailto: link.                          |
| `phone`            | yes      | string         | pattern `^\+[1-9]\d{6,14}$`          | E.164 (DS-11). Shown only after a click (PhoneReveal).                |
| `whatsapp`         | yes      | object         |                                      |                                                                       |
| `whatsapp.number`  | yes      | string         | pattern `^\d{7,15}$`                 | Digits only, country code first, as wa.me expects (DS-11).            |
| `whatsapp.message` | yes      | string         |                                      | Prefilled first message.                                              |
| `links`            | yes      | list of object | at least 1                           |                                                                       |
| `links[].id`       | yes      | string         | pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$` |                                                                       |
| `links[].label`    | yes      | string         |                                      |                                                                       |
| `links[].url`      | yes      | string         | uri; pattern `^https://`             |                                                                       |
| `links[].handle`   | yes      | string         |                                      | What the link shows, e.g. @factman60.                                 |
| `responseTime`     | yes      | string         |                                      | Shown as written, e.g. "within 24 hours".                             |
| `timezone`         | yes      | string         | pattern `^[A-Za-z]+/[A-Za-z_]+$`     | IANA time zone; pages show its abbreviation and offset (WAT · UTC+1). |
| `city`             | yes      | string         |                                      |                                                                       |
| `country`          | yes      | string         |                                      |                                                                       |

## `resumes.json`

The downloadable résumés (PRD FR-38 to FR-49, canvas page 06). Each résumé picks its roles, skills and projects from the other data files; only role-specific wording lives here. Text may use {years} (years since profile.careerStart), {since:<skill id>} (that skill's start year) and [placeholders] filled from `placeholders`.

One object:

| Field                                | Required | Type                     | Rules                                                                                                                                       | Notes                                                                                                                       |
| ------------------------------------ | -------- | ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `placeholders`                       | yes      | list of object           |                                                                                                                                             | Values for the [bracketed] tokens in résumé text. A token without a value stays in the text and is highlighted on previews. |
| `placeholders[].token`               | yes      | string                   | pattern `^\[[^\[\]\n]+\]$`                                                                                                                  | Exactly as it appears in the text, brackets included.                                                                       |
| `placeholders[].value`               | yes      | string or null           |                                                                                                                                             | Replacement text; null until the owner supplies it.                                                                         |
| `placeholders[].note`                |          | string                   |                                                                                                                                             | Where the token is used, to help fill it in.                                                                                |
| `resumes`                            | yes      | list of object           | at least 1                                                                                                                                  |                                                                                                                             |
| `resumes[].id`                       | yes      | string                   | pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`                                                                                                        | Used by highlight `tracks` in experience.json.                                                                              |
| `resumes[].slug`                     | yes      | string                   | pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`                                                                                                        |                                                                                                                             |
| `resumes[].title`                    | yes      | string                   |                                                                                                                                             | Card title, footer and running header, e.g. Mobile Developer.                                                               |
| `resumes[].headline`                 | yes      | string                   |                                                                                                                                             | Role line under the name.                                                                                                   |
| `resumes[].scope`                    | yes      | string                   | at most 90 characters                                                                                                                       | One line on the résumé card (RS-02).                                                                                        |
| `resumes[].icon`                     | yes      | string                   | pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`                                                                                                        |                                                                                                                             |
| `resumes[].fileName`                 | yes      | string                   | pattern `^[a-z0-9-]+\.pdf$`                                                                                                                 |                                                                                                                             |
| `resumes[].paper`                    | yes      | fixed                    | `A4`                                                                                                                                        |                                                                                                                             |
| `resumes[].pages`                    | yes      | object                   |                                                                                                                                             | 2 pages as standard, 3 at most (ETE-222).                                                                                   |
| `resumes[].pages.target`             | yes      | integer                  | ≥ 1                                                                                                                                         |                                                                                                                             |
| `resumes[].pages.max`                | yes      | integer                  | ≥ 1                                                                                                                                         |                                                                                                                             |
| `resumes[].showPhone`                | yes      | boolean                  |                                                                                                                                             | Requires a phone in contact.json (RS-03).                                                                                   |
| `resumes[].links`                    | yes      | list of string           | no repeats; each: pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`                                                                                      | contact.json link ids shown in the header.                                                                                  |
| `resumes[].showWebsite`              | yes      | boolean                  |                                                                                                                                             | Show the site URL (site.json) in the header.                                                                                |
| `resumes[].summary`                  | yes      | string                   | at most 500 characters                                                                                                                      | Profile paragraph (RS-02).                                                                                                  |
| `resumes[].sections`                 | yes      | list of one of           | at least 1; no repeats; each: `profile`, `skills`, `experience`, `earlier`, `clients`, `projects`, `education`, `languages`, `publications` |                                                                                                                             |
| `resumes[].skillGroups`              | yes      | list of object           | at least 1                                                                                                                                  |                                                                                                                             |
| `resumes[].skillGroups[].label`      | yes      | string                   |                                                                                                                                             |                                                                                                                             |
| `resumes[].skillGroups[].items`      | yes      | list of string or object | at least 1                                                                                                                                  |                                                                                                                             |
| `resumes[].experience`               | yes      | object                   |                                                                                                                                             |                                                                                                                             |
| `resumes[].experience.roles`         | yes      | list of string or object | at least 1                                                                                                                                  | Full entries in order. A string is a role id; {merge} shows several roles of one organization as one entry.                 |
| `resumes[].experience.earlier`       | yes      | list of string           | no repeats; each: pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`                                                                                      | Role ids shown one line each under Earlier experience. Roles in neither list are left out.                                  |
| `resumes[].experience.stacks`        |          | object                   |                                                                                                                                             | Stack line per organization id.                                                                                             |
| `resumes[].projects`                 | yes      | list of object or object |                                                                                                                                             |                                                                                                                             |
| `resumes[].limits`                   | yes      | object                   |                                                                                                                                             | Caps checked by data:validate (RS-02).                                                                                      |
| `resumes[].limits.skills`            | yes      | integer                  | ≥ 5                                                                                                                                         |                                                                                                                             |
| `resumes[].limits.roles`             | yes      | integer                  | ≥ 1                                                                                                                                         |                                                                                                                             |
| `resumes[].limits.highlightsPerRole` | yes      | integer                  | ≥ 1                                                                                                                                         |                                                                                                                             |
| `resumes[].limits.projects`          | yes      | integer                  | ≥ 0                                                                                                                                         |                                                                                                                             |

## `site.json`

Site-wide settings: SEO, navigation, analytics IDs, consent and feature flags (PRD §7, §10). Anything environment-specific lives here, with per-environment overrides under `environments` (PRD §8: no value is read from window or env vars at run time).

One object:

| Field                                    | Required | Type           | Rules                                          | Notes                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ---------------------------------------- | -------- | -------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `url`                                    | yes      | string         | uri; pattern `^https://[^/]+$`                 | Canonical origin, no trailing slash: https://www.factman.dev (the apex factman.dev redirects to it).                                                                                       |
| `name`                                   | yes      | string         |                                                | Site and owner name used in titles and Open Graph.                                                                                                                                         |
| `titleTemplate`                          | yes      | string         | pattern `%s`                                   | Page title template; %s is replaced by the page title.                                                                                                                                     |
| `description`                            | yes      | string         | at least 50 characters; at most 160 characters | Default meta description (50 to 160 characters).                                                                                                                                           |
| `ogImage`                                |          | string         |                                                | Default Open Graph image (1200 × 630), relative to src/assets. Generated by `pnpm ds:og` from the data files (ETE-198); every page shares it in its Open Graph and Twitter tags (ETE-112). |
| `ogImageAlt`                             |          | string         |                                                | Alt text of the Open Graph image (og:image:alt, twitter:image:alt): what the image shows, for people who can't see it.                                                                     |
| `locale`                                 | yes      | string         | pattern `^[a-z]{2}_[A-Z]{2}$`                  |                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `robots`                                 | yes      | one of         | `index`, `noindex`                             |                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `nav`                                    | yes      | list of object | at least 1                                     |                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `nav[].id`                               | yes      | string         | pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`           |                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `nav[].label`                            | yes      | string         |                                                |                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `nav[].anchor`                           | yes      | string         | pattern `^#[a-z0-9-]+$`                        | Section anchor on the home page.                                                                                                                                                           |
| `nav[].route`                            |          | string         | pattern `^/[a-z0-9/-]*$`                       | Page to open from any other page; without it, links go to /<anchor>.                                                                                                                       |
| `blog`                                   | yes      | object         |                                                | Blog (ETE-32): articles are read live from Medium in the browser, never stored in the site.                                                                                                |
| `blog.profile`                           | yes      | string         | uri; pattern `^https://medium\.com/`           | Medium profile, linked when the feed can't load.                                                                                                                                           |
| `blog.feed`                              | yes      | string         | uri; pattern `^https://medium\.com/feed/`      | Medium RSS feed. vercel.json rewrites feedPath to it (test:headers checks they match).                                                                                                     |
| `blog.feedPath`                          | yes      | string         | pattern `^/[a-z0-9/-]+$`                       | Same-origin path the browser fetches; Medium's feed sends no CORS header.                                                                                                                  |
| `blog.cacheHours`                        | yes      | number         | > 0                                            | How long the browser keeps the articles in localStorage (fm_blog).                                                                                                                         |
| `analytics`                              | yes      | object         |                                                |                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `analytics.enabled`                      | yes      | boolean        |                                                |                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `analytics.gtmId`                        | yes      | string or null |                                                | Google Tag Manager container ID (DS-12).                                                                                                                                                   |
| `analytics.ga4Id`                        | yes      | string or null |                                                | GA4 measurement ID (G-…, not the numeric property ID); null until known.                                                                                                                   |
| `consent`                                | yes      | object         |                                                |                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `consent.version`                        | yes      | integer        | ≥ 1                                            | Bump to re-prompt every visitor (stored decision carries the version).                                                                                                                     |
| `consent.cookie`                         | yes      | string         | pattern `^[a-z_]+$`                            |                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `consent.maxAgeDays`                     | yes      | integer        | ≥ 1; ≤ 395                                     |                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `consent.categories`                     | yes      | list of object | at least 1                                     |                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `consent.categories[].id`                | yes      | one of         | `necessary`, `analytics`, `advertising`        |                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `consent.categories[].label`             | yes      | string         |                                                |                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `consent.categories[].description`       | yes      | string         |                                                |                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `consent.categories[].required`          | yes      | boolean        |                                                | Always on; cannot be switched off.                                                                                                                                                         |
| `consent.categories[].defaultGranted`    | yes      | boolean        |                                                |                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `consent.categories[].used`              |          | boolean        |                                                | False for categories listed only to say they are not used.                                                                                                                                 |
| `consent.categories[].storage`           | yes      | list of string |                                                | Cookies or storage keys in this category, with lifetime (shown on /privacy).                                                                                                               |
| `features`                               | yes      | object         |                                                | Flags for the v1.1 (P1) items; all off in v1.0 (PRD §4).                                                                                                                                   |
| `features.stackFilter`                   | yes      | boolean        |                                                |                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `features.expandableRoles`               | yes      | boolean        |                                                |                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `features.blogTagFilter`                 | yes      | boolean        |                                                |                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `features.contributionGraph`             | yes      | boolean        |                                                |                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `features.terminal`                      | yes      | boolean        |                                                |                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `features.scrollSpy`                     | yes      | boolean        |                                                |                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `defaultTheme`                           | yes      | one of         | `system`, `light`, `dark`                      | FR-04: follow the system preference until the visitor chooses.                                                                                                                             |
| `environments`                           | yes      | object         |                                                | Overrides applied on top of the base settings per deployment environment. Production uses the base values.                                                                                 |
| `environments.preview`                   | yes      | object         |                                                |                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `environments.preview.robots`            |          | one of         | `index`, `noindex`                             |                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `environments.preview.analytics`         |          | object         |                                                |                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `environments.preview.analytics.enabled` |          | boolean        |                                                |                                                                                                                                                                                            |

## `clients.json`

Clients and companies for the "Worked with" strip (PRD FR-51, FR-52). An empty list is valid: the strip is then omitted.

A list of client records. Each record:

| Field     | Required | Type    | Rules                                                                       | Notes                                                                               |
| --------- | -------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`      | yes      | integer | ≥ 1                                                                         |                                                                                     |
| `order`   | yes      | integer | ≥ 1                                                                         | Position in the strip (ascending).                                                  |
| `slug`    | yes      | string  | pattern `^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`                                        |                                                                                     |
| `name`    | yes      | string  |                                                                             | Display name; also the logo's alt text.                                             |
| `type`    | yes      | one of  | `client`, `company`                                                         |                                                                                     |
| `website` |          | string  | uri; pattern `^https://`                                                    | Optional; without it the logo is not a link.                                        |
| `logo`    | yes      | string  | pattern `^clients/[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*\.(?:png\|svg\|webp\|avif\|jpg)$` | Logo file relative to src/assets, e.g. clients/simple-finance.png.                  |
| `plate`   | yes      | one of  | `light`, `dark`                                                             | Plate the logo sits on so it stays visible in both themes (dark for white artwork). |
| `ratio`   | yes      | number  | > 0                                                                         | Logo width ÷ height, to reserve space without layout shift.                         |
| `source`  |          | string  | uri; pattern `^https://`                                                    | Where the logo was originally taken from (provenance).                              |
